semantics.exclusive_scan: output[i] is the modulo-2^32 sum of input[0..i)
semantics.selection: arbitrary nonzero predicates are normalized to 1, then survivors are emitted in increasing input-index order
semantics.radix_sort: stable eight-pass LSD sort with four key bits per pass
semantics.run_length_encoding: ordered run keys, starts, and lengths
semantics.segmented_scan: exclusive modulo-2^32 sum; head flags are exactly 0 or 1 and nonempty input requires head_flags[0] == 1
semantics.segmented_reduction: one modulo-2^32 sum per ordered segment

aliasing.v1: all input, output, metadata, and temporary ranges are disjoint unless an entry explicitly mutates its output in place

publication.cloud_source_lane: two-root reproducible SPIR64 LLVM bitcode plus semantic tests
publication.cloud_candidate_lane: locked Ubuntu 26.04 Clang/llvm-spirv/ocloc/IGC bake emits candidate SPIR-V, Zebin, manifests, and generated Rust contracts
publication.production_lane: not admitted until candidate ISA/ABI review, runtime wiring, and a physical ADL-S transcript
